body: Current state, 2026-08-29: owner-appointed lead codex-movie-architecture is resolving D1-D10 under docs/plans/2026-08-29-movie-narrative-architecture.md. Accepted north star: one shared narrative model; raw multimodal evidence, persistent modality-specific source/feature artifacts, then joined semantic proposals and critic findings; fuse interpretations late and retain evidence early. Controlling amendments: typed native PTS/edition composition and rendition identity; non-convertible acoustic/face/appearance/character domains; immutable timed-text lattice; claim-family status licensing; request/call/payload/support joins; execution identity distinct from independence; realized-output cache identity; permutation ties remain Alternatives; typed boundary layers; SourceFrozen transitive leakage exclusion; validated compilation required for alignment; StoryAtlas is a separate pinned-artifact consumer. Authorization state: P0 compiler seam landed at e661470 but proves mechanical reachability only. P1 real-transcript Stage 1b research gate is OUTSTANDING and blocks movie implementation. B0/Q5 Sherlock plus asset/component admission is independently OUTSTANDING; no exact source-film plus human-recall pair is admitted. No decoder, dependency, model, source fetch, API migration, or visualization work is authorized. ADR 0007 board ratification record and its Proposed file header still need ADR-authority reconciliation.
